title: an external project's clone, worktrees and records live under FM_HOME (~/.firstmate/projects/<name>/), outside the engine's working tree
acceptance: Why. On 2026-09-29 the captain approved the redesign for working on other repositories (reviewed and grilled against an external organisation's repository PR #164): external data outside the engine tree under FM_HOME, private repositories allowed, watching done by scripts at zero model cost, with visible owned Herdr dispatch retained; detached full cmux lifecycle remains deferred. Its own spec file, design/tasks/T-142.json, is committed on this branch.

FM_HOME (default ~/.firstmate; env or config.yaml `home:`) holds projects/<name>/{repo,worktrees,CONVENTIONS.md,tasks,design.md,state}. fm-project.sh sync clones there instead of state/projects/<name>/repo; T-128's mirrors and every per-project record for an external project go there. The self project (repo: .) is unchanged.

No path under FM_HOME may be inside the engine's working tree (refused, exit 65), so git clean, lint and find sweeps, T-128's mirror and editors never meet a nested repository. An existing state/projects/<name>/repo is moved once with the operator's word, never silently.

Optional history: `fm project history on <name>` makes FM_HOME/projects/<name>/ a local git repository excluding repo/ and worktrees/, so the project's specs and conventions have history without reaching any remote. Evidence: the required GitHub check and the gates, checked by firstmate at the merge gate. Workers do not run the suites themselves. Stubs answer as the real tools do.

External project data lives only under FM_HOME/projects/<name>/{repo,worktrees,CONVENTIONS.md,tasks,design.md,state}. No private specs, worktrees, prompts, pins, evidence, mirrors or recovery data in engine state or its public tree. Private repos are accepted. Unreadable protection is unknown: require captain-confirmed project checks and policy before readiness, never infer permission or reject solely for visibility. Every GitHub operation names the project repository. Preserve self-project default and explicit-name compatibility. Never push to protected base; task-branch force-with-lease requires confirmed project policy and expected old head. Merge method, deletion, land/review/post and stacking follow CONVENTIONS.md, never hardcoded squash/delete.

Evidence: required GitHub checks and commit statuses plus six gates 1,2,4,5,6,7 on the authoritative current PR head; gate 3 is retired. Workers author feature-owned fail-first tests but run no suites. Tests stay at most 1200 lines; shared fixtures in tests/lib/ or tests/e2e/lib/, with literal helper references. Firstmate verifies CI/gates and real acceptance; a structure check cannot prove model compliance. Commit this task spec with implementation.

Validate names, canonical roots, symlink/traversal escapes, clone origin and direct-child cleanup before mutation. Cover every external store including events, decisions, diagrams, context packs, wake/recovery records and live-owned review checkouts; engine board aggregation contains only authorized metadata. Approved migration verifies retained records and rollback/recovery before removal. Test self compatibility, rejected paths and no private engine-state copies.
